علي بن إبراهيم بن مهزيار الاهوازي

notes: «وأخبرنا جماعة» and «عن رجـل» (who «لم يذكر اسمه») are unnamed transmitters; the Qazvin description between dashes is left out.
Habib's «قال: دخلت إلى علي بن إبراهيم» is a first-person narrative; Ali speaks inside it and is the last named link (rule 6).
needs_ruling: the young man («فتى») who speaks the Imam's words inside Ali's account is not named in the text (rule 11: first-person narrative with an unnamed speaker).
